mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exam_documents (exam_id, document_type, original_name, stored_name, file_path, mime_type, file_size, page_no, uploaded_by) VALUES (#{examId}, #{documentType}, #{originalName}, #{storedName}, #{filePath}, #{mimeType}, #{fileSize}, #{pageNo}, #{uploadedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT exam_document_id, exam_id, document_type, original_name, stored_name, file_path, mime_type, file_size, page_no, uploaded_by, created_at FROM exam_documents WHERE exam_document_id = #{examDocumentId}

SELECT exam_document_id, exam_id, document_type, original_name, stored_name, file_path, mime_type, file_size, page_no, uploaded_by, created_at FROM exam_documents WHERE exam_id = #{examId} ORDER BY document_type, page_no NULLS LAST, exam_document_id
